description: A Kazan-Dun hearth-guard given leave to walk out of the mountain with the outsider who settled the succession. He does not talk about which side he wanted to win. He carries a tower shield, stands where he is told, and considers the arrangement a debt being paid down rather than a job.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: Plants the tower shield and soaks what comes at the party

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.description: Forces nearby enemies to come at Durn instead of anyone squishier

idle_lines: This sky is too far away. I will get used to it.
Morgrim gave me leave. Vurka signed it too. That took them an hour.
We buried him properly. That is the part that mattered.
